banner.heading: Cookies
banner.body: We use cookies to understand how this service is used, so that we can improve it. You decide what you consent to.

dialog.heading: Cookie settings
dialog.body: Necessary cookies are always on, because the service does not work without them. The rest is up to you.
dialog.alwaysOnBody: These store nothing on your device and cannot be used to recognise you. They therefore do not require consent, and are always on.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Required for the service to work, including sign-in and security. These cannot be turned off.

functionality.title: Functionality
functionality.description: Remembers your choices, such as language and other settings.

measurement.title: Statistics
measurement.description: Lets us count visits and see which pages are used, so we can prioritise correctly.

experience.title: User experience
experience.description: Lets us see how the pages are actually used, through anonymised recordings and heatmaps, so we can fix what is difficult.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to tailor advertising. Kystverket does not use this today.
